title: Student Mobilization Network Analysis
description: Explore which students are frequently used together and identify central picks in raid team compositions.

ranking.pageRankDesc: PageRank: centrality weighted by the importance of co-occurring students, not just raw count. Higher-ranked neighbors boost the score.
ranking.betweennessDesc: Betweenness: how often a student lies on the shortest path between two others. High value → key bridge in team compositions. Removal likely to fragment connections.
ranking.strengthDesc: Total co-occurrence count across all other students. The most direct measure of overall usage frequency.
ranking.degreeDesc: Number of unique students co-occurred with. High degree → appears across many different team compositions. Good indicator of versatility.

nodeDetail.clickToSeeDetails: Click a node to see details

canvas.instructionsHint: Click a node to focus · Drag to move · Scroll to zoom
canvas.selectSeasons: Select seasons from the Filter tab to begin.
canvas.noMatches: No data matches the current filters.
